shellCommands.command: git status --short && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null | head -100 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -200

cat AGENTS.md && echo --- && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -60 && echo --- && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules | grep -i -E 'date|gravity' ; echo "--- npm view:"; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -30; npm view @gravity-ui/date-utils version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20

npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -40; for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[],"' | grep -E '^[0-9]' | tail -40); do echo -n "$v uikit="; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@$v peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/uikit 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n'; echo -n " date-utils="; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@$v peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/date-utils 2>/dev/null; echo; done 2>/dev/null

for v in 2.10.3 2.11.0 2.12.0 3.0.3 3.1.1 3.2.4 3.3.2 3.4.2 4.0.0 4.1.0; do echo -n "$v uikit="; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@$v peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const p=JSON.parse(s||"{}");console.log((p["@gravity-ui/uikit"]||"-")+" date-utils="+(p["@gravity-ui/date-utils"]||"-")+" react="+(p.react||"-"))})'; done

npm install --save-exact @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@^2.6.0 2>&1 | grep -v 'npm warn Unknown env' | tail -20; echo "---"; git diff --stat; node -e 'for (const p of ["date-components","date-utils","uikit"]) console.log(p, require("./node_modules/@gravity-ui/"+p+"/package.json").version)'; grep -A3 '"dependencies"' package.json

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh date-components Calendar DatePicker RangeCalendar CalendarDate 2>&1 | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist | head -50

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components && grep -n "types\|typings" package.json | head; f=$(grep -rl "CalendarProps" dist/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -3); echo "$f"; for x in $f; do echo "== $x"; done; grep -rn "export.*Calendar\b\|export declare const Calendar\|interface CalendarProps\|onUpdate\|value?:\|defaultValue" $(grep -rl "CalendarProps" dist --include=*.d.ts | head -5) | head -40; echo; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -rn "dateTime\b\|export.*dateTime" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/dist/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/dist | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components && cat dist/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts; echo ====; grep -rn "CalendarCommonProps" dist/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -3; f=$(grep -rl "interface CalendarCommonProps\|type CalendarCommonProps" dist/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -1); echo "== $f"; cat "$f" | head -80; echo ====; ls ../date-utils; grep -n '"version"\|"types"' ../date-utils/package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/useCalendarState.d.ts | head -60; echo ====; grep -n "export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/index.d.ts | head -20; echo ====; grep -n "export declare function dateTime\b\|dateTime(\|export.*dateTime\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/index.d.ts | head -5

grep -rn "ValueBase" -A12 node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/types/index.d.ts | head -30; echo ===; grep -n "dateTime\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/*.d.ts | head -5; echo ===; cat src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -30

f=$(grep -rl "interface ValueBase\|type ValueBase" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -1); echo $f; grep -n "ValueBase" -A10 "$f" | head -25; echo ===; grep -rn "onUpdate" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/useCalendarState.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo ===; grep -n "export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/index.d.ts | head -20

grep -n "lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/*/ThemeProvider*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rln "lang?:" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | grep -i theme | head -3; echo ===; grep -n "format\|interface DateTime\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/typings.d.ts | head -10; echo ===; grep -rn "loadLocale" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build --include=*.d.ts | head -3; echo ===; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides 2>/dev/null

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/ | head -30; grep -rn "format(" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build --include=*.d.ts | head -5; echo ===; grep -rln "interface DateTime\b\|type DateTime\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build --include=*.d.ts | head -3

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Flex Text ThemeProvider 2>&1 | head -40; echo ===; d=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; grep -n "direction\|gap" $(grep -rl "export interface FlexProps\|FlexProps" $d --include=*.d.ts | head -2) | head -12; echo ===; grep -n "color\|variant" $(grep -rl "export interface TextProps\|TextProps" $d/components/Text --include=*.d.ts | head -1) | head -12

grep -n "color" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/typography/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -8 || true; f=$(find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -name "colorText.d.ts" | head -1); echo "$f"; grep -n "secondary\|color" "$f" | head -8
npm run build > /tmp/build.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; grep -i "error\|warn" /tmp/build.log | head; rm -rf dist; git status --short
